protocolDescription: Focused model-only extraction: medicines, followUps/appointments, highlights, per source chunk. Greedy Metal,4096 context,1536/1024/768 token limits. No source recovery; validators only reject candidates. Raw facts and accepted facts are separate. Exact-field scoring is not clinical validation. Development results are not held-out results. Dataset role and description: Separate authored holdout for focused prompts. Gold labels are engineering references, not clinician-reviewed. Run after prompt freeze; do not tune prompts on these results. No source-recovery additions are allowed.
